purpose: Defines source-specific runner routing, adapter identity, rank capability, scope support, and retry capability for Calendar acquisition systems.
closure_rules: every record must contain a non-empty primary_runner from runner_enum
fallback_runner may be null but when present must use runner_enum and differ from primary_runner
technical_capability_rank and public_ceiling must use rank_enum
collection_target_rank must be best_available or a rank not above technical_capability_rank
public_ceiling must not exceed the approved system policy ceiling
supported_observation_ranks must be a non-empty unique subset of rank_enum
active profiles require non-null schedule_source_id, detail_source_id, schedule_adapter_id, and detail_adapter_id
provisional profiles may use null source or adapter fields only when each null field is named in pending_fields
supports_selected_meetings may be true only when an active adapter path exists and system-specific operation supports selected meeting input
all source IDs must resolve to the reviewed authority/source inventory when non-null
technical_capability_rank and public_ceiling must agree with reviewed Japan system policy for initial Japan profiles
explicit_exclusions: no source bodies or raw HTML
no participant horse jockey trainer betting odds result payout prediction or tip data
no credentials cookies tokens restricted-access details or bypass instructions
no approval promotion publication or deployment side effects
